sentences.text: Adapala Madhava Rao Madhava, vs The State Of Andhra

Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
Bench: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition No.4342 of 2020
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking a direction to the Station House Officer, Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District, to release the vehicle and tobacco that were seized in Crime No.203 of 2020 to the petitioners.

entities.text: Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.
3.

A case in Crime No.203 of 2020 was registered against the petitioners for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 420, 270, 273 of IPC and Sections 57(1), 58 and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act.

The petitioners sought quash of the said F.I.R. registered against them in Crl.P.
No.4188 of 2020 before this Court.
The said Criminal Petition was allowed by this Court as per order dated 29.09.2020 and the F.I.R. registered against the petitioners was quashed.

Therefore, the petitioners, against whom the F.I.R. was quashed, are entitled for the custody of Eicher Lorry bearing Registration No.TS15UD 9634 and the tobacco products that were seized by the police in connection with the said crime from their possession.

In fact, this is a covered matter and this Court earlier in Crl.P.No.11144 of 2018, based on similar facts, ordered for release of the seized products to the CMR, J.
petitioner therein against whom the F.I.R. was quashed.
On the basis of the said order, subsequent orders were also passed by this Court in various Criminal Petitions.
4. Therefore, the petitioners, who are similarly placed, are also entitled to the similar relief.

5. In the result, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the Station House Officer, Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District, is directed release Eicher Lorry bearing Registration No.TS15UD 9634 and the tobacco products that were seized to the petitioners on proper acknowledgement and identification.
